brief:
Palestinian lawmaker Ahmad Tibi has called on Israeli military figure Gadi Eisenkot to demonstrate "courage" by forming a minority government with support from Arab parties, Middle East Eye reported. Tibi said Arab political factions are prepared to back an Eisenkot-led administration, framing the arrangement as a potential path forward for Israeli governance.

The proposal reflects efforts by Palestinian political representatives to influence Israeli coalition negotiations, positioning Arab parties as kingmakers in a fragmented parliament.

title: Palestinian lawmaker urges Israeli general to form minority government with Arab backing
